blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval folding stool (faldstool). It features curved wooden X-shaped legs connected by turned stretchers, four vertical posts capped with pyramid-shaped finials, and a sagging rectangular sling seat made of red leather or fabric with fringed edges. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and cleanly modeled in a hand-painted game-asset style, resting flat on four feet without any external plinth or base.
blind.from_above: A rectangular red leather sling seat stretched across two support bars, pinned at the four corners by pointed finials.
blind.height_vs_figure: Approximately 1.5 to 2 feet tall (reaching around knee-height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 to 2 feet wide.
